TmDataDisplayDemo_AnimatedHint: Each number counts to its target. Assistive technology is handed the final value once, and a number that changes mid-count continues from where it already is.
TmDataDisplayDemo_SessionsToast: The Sessions card is a button: one native focus stop.
TmDataDisplayDemo_FacetFilterHint: Grouped options with result counts, a search box inside a long group, a "Show more" truncation and the active filters as removable chips. On a phone the popover becomes a bottom sheet; the right card is the inline presentation.
TmDataDisplayDemo_TrendListHint: One row per metric with its change over the period. Direction travels as an arrow, a tone and a word, and the table layout gives the numbers real column headers.
TmDataDisplayDemo_BreakdownHint: Pick a period and the biggest channel changes, so the rows re-order (a FLIP transition, suppressed for reduced motion). The strip is decorative — the table carries the numbers.
TmDataDisplayDemo_BreakdownFixtureHint: Live proof of the row identity: two parts have an EMPTY Id and two share the same one. The card derives a private key for every row that does not own a unique one, so the whole table renders and the period switch still re-sorts it.
TmSankeyChartDemo_Description: Follow monthly income through the household budget into spending and savings. Hover a node or flow to trace its connections, then select it for details.
TmSankeyChartDemo_ClickPrompt: Select a node or flow to inspect it.
TmChartDemo_PageDescription: Pure SVG charts with no JavaScript dependencies, including stacked bars, multi-series areas and cumulative waterfalls.
TmChartDemo_AreaBalance: Operating and reserve balances, two series
TmChartDemo_AreaEdge: Gradient fill, negative values and a missing point
TmChartDemo_StackedDescription: Vertical and horizontal views share the same monthly expense composition. Toggle a category to remove it from every stack.
TmChartDemo_WaterfallStandard: Cashflow: opening balance, receipts, expenses and final balance
TmChartDemo_IndexTooltipDescription: Both series are read at one category: hovering anywhere in a month draws the crosshair and lists every series at that index. The chart is one tab stop — the arrow keys walk the months, Home and End jump to the edges and Escape hides the card.
TmChartDemo_IndexManyAriaLabel: Filings, rulings, appeals, motions, hearings, notices and settlements per month
TmChartDemo_SparklineExtrasDescription: Every sparkline now names its own numbers, and the opt-in tooltip adds a focus stop with arrow-key navigation, a min/max caption and a last-value ring.
TmToolbarDemo_OverflowIntro: Buttons that do not fit move into a More menu, Secondary buttons first; Export and Delete are overflow-only and always live there. The menu is a bottom sheet on a phone. Arrow keys move between the buttons.
TmToolbarDemo_RibbonTitle: Ribbon with labels below the icons
TmToolbarDemo_RibbonDescription: Icon over label, groups separated by dividers - the tablet layout of the diagram editor mockup.
TmToolbarDemo_PressedDescription: A button with Pressed renders aria-pressed and the pressed look; collapsed into the More menu it is a checkable entry (menuitemcheckbox) with the same state. Activating it closes the menu and toggles.
TmToolbarDemo_LabelsDescription: Auto shows button labels and drops them when the toolbar itself is narrower than 640 px (the text stays the accessible name).
TmToolbarDemo_FileButtonDescription: A Secondary file button leaves the bar into More like any other button; its More entry opens the same file chooser. Narrow the bar and pick a JSON file from either place.
TmToolbarDemo_ItemsIntro: Selects, colour pickers and toggles leave the bar like buttons: the wrapper is one measured item, it collapses whole, and in More it is a plain entry or a labelled group.
TmToolbarDemo_ItemsColorDialogBody: The full colour picker opened from the More menu (the menu stays open under it).
TmToolbarDemo_PreserveFocusTitle: Buttons that do not steal focus (PreserveFocus)
TmToolbarDemo_PreserveFocusDescription: A toolbar button with PreserveFocus does not take focus on a pointer press, so the text selection in the field survives the formatting command.
TmToolbarDemo_PreserveFocusSample: Select part of this text, then press a formatting button — the selection survives.
TmToolbarDemo_GroupDescription: A TmToolbarGroup renders role=group with an accessible name and the data-tm-toolbar-group marker: its buttons still collapse individually and come back when there is room. Save is pinned and never moves into More.
TmToolbarDemo_GroupMenuTitle: Grouped commands in the More menu
TmToolbarDemo_GroupMenuDescription: Buttons grouped in TmToolbarGroup keep a labelled section in the More menu; the arrow keys cross the groups and skip the headings.
TmToolbarDemo_ConditionalDescription: A button inserted in the middle of the bar after the first render: the More menu and the tie-break follow the DOM order.
TmToolbarDemo_OverflowOnlyMidDescription: Export is written between New and Copy and lives only in More: the menu keeps that written position.
TmToolbarDemo_ShrinkDescription: The toolbar is a size container with no intrinsic width: in a space-between flex row it needs flex: 1 1 auto; min-width: 0.
TmMobileActionBarDemo_Intro: A component-scoped action bar: up to three actions stay on the bar, the rest overflow into a More menu. Resize the window below 640 px (or open this page on a phone) and the bar appears; above the breakpoint it does not exist.
TmMobileActionBarDemo_AutoTitle: Auto visibility, sticky in the container
TmMobileActionBarDemo_AutoDescription: The bar below belongs to this card. Scroll the page: it sticks to the bottom edge only while its container is in view; the content scrolls beneath it. Only the deliberate FixedViewport variant reserves clearance for itself.
TmMobileActionBarDemo_ForcedDescription: The same bar with a forced mobile layout, so it renders at any window width. The second variant anchors to the viewport deliberately (FixedViewport); the third is static (Inline).
TmMobileActionBarDemo_FixedBody: This content scrolls under the viewport-anchored bar; the reserve below equals the bar height.
TmMobileActionBarDemo_ConfirmDeleteMessa: The document will be moved to the trash. You can restore it later.
TmDataTableDemo_ExportDescription: Open the Export menu to download every matching row, or only the rows you have checked, as CSV or as a typed Excel workbook (XLSX).
TmDataTableDemo_InlineEditDescription: Edit the amount, category, and note in place. DataAnnotations block invalid values, and a successful save reports the OnRowSave callback below. Cancel callbacks receive the mutated item, so applications that need rollback must restore their own snapshot.
TmDataTableDemo_SavePlaceholder: Save a valid row to see the OnRowSave result.
TmDataTableDemo_RedesignDescription: Every control below is off by default. Turn one on to see that opt-in without changing the tables above.
TmDataTableDemo_MobileCardsDescription: This container is 24rem wide, so the cards layout is visible on a desktop too.
TmDataTableDemo_ViewsDescription: The panel lists personal views, shows the active view's name and offers Set as default. The container is 24rem wide, so the panel becomes a sheet.
TmDataTableDemo_FilterDemoDescription: Popover keeps the editor anchored. Auto uses the same panel and becomes a sheet below 640px. Both show how many people match.
TmDataTableDemo_EdgeDescription: Fixed data for the end-to-end and screenshot specs: an empty table, no results after a search, a loading table, a very long cell and view name, and fifteen columns that scroll.
TmDataTableDemo_EdgeLongHeading: Very long cell text and view name
TmDataTableDemo_EdgeLongName: Maximilian Alexander Bartholomew Christopher Fitzgerald-Montgomery the Third of Westminster and Greater Manchester
TmDataTableDemo_EdgeLongView: Engineering and Platform department — quarterly pipeline review for the northern and eastern regions
TmMvlDemo_EdgeLongTitle: Maximilian Alexander Bartholomew Christopher Fitzgerald-Montgomery the Third of Westminster
TmMvlDemo_EdgeLongSubtitle: Principal staff engineer responsible for the platform, tooling and developer experience organisation across every region
TmDataTableDemo_EdgePagerHeading: Pager in a wide and a narrow container
TmDataTableDemo_GridEditDescription: F2 starts editing the focused row, Escape cancels and returns focus to the cell.
TmMvlDemo_RedesignDescription: Every control below is off by default. Turn one on to see that opt-in without changing the lists above.
TmDiagramDemo_InteractiveDescription: The canvas below is pre-loaded with a UML Class stencil. Drag from a port to create edges.
TmDiagramDemo_PageDescription: Declarative diagram editor with stencil-based nodes, SVG edges, and hybrid HTML/SVG rendering. Drag stencils from the toolbox, connect ports, and export as JSON.
TmEditorShellDemo_Intro: A responsive three-region frame for canvas editors: docked, resizable panels on desktop and tablet (one expanded on a tablet), canvas + a panels sheet and an action bar on mobile. Resize the window to watch it adapt.
TmEditorShellDemo_CanvasBody: We are glad you joined us. Here are a few tips to get started.
TmEditorShellDemo_CanvasFooter: You received this email because you signed up for our newsletter.
TmEditorShellDemo_ThresholdsIntro: The same shell with its own thresholds (desktop from 1200, mobile below 768, like the e-mail editor). On a tablet the toolbox collapses to an icon rail and one panel stays expanded.
TmEditorShellDemo_OverlayIntro: The same shell with TabletPanelPresentation.Overlay (desktop from 1200, mobile below 768). On a tablet the toolbox is an overlay drawer and the properties a non-modal side sheet over a full-width canvas - at most one open, driven by the toolbar buttons, closed by the x or Escape. Desktop keeps the docked panels.
TmSidePanelDemo_Intro: A standalone responsive inspector: docked in-flow on a desktop container, a modal side sheet on a narrower container, a bottom sheet on a phone viewport. Shrink the window to watch it adapt.
TmSidePanelDemo_InspectorBody: A standalone inspector for surfaces that are not full editors — a scheduler event, a Gantt task, a record detail.
TmDemo_InlineSheetBody: The canvas behind this sheet stays clickable.
TmDemo_LongCustomDialogFiller: Filler paragraph {0} — enough content to make the dialog scroller overflow.
TmDemo_MobileSheet: Opt-in bottom sheet on a phone (MobilePresentation = Auto)
TmDemo_FocusRestoreBody: This form starts in its first field. Close it (X, Cancel or Esc) and focus returns to the button that opened it. OK moves focus to "Post-close action" instead.
TmDemo_FocusRestoreNestedMessage: A dialog opened on top of the modal. Closing it returns the focus to the button that opened it.
TmModelingEditor_DemoError: Demo modeling provider failed to load the model.
TmModelingViewerDemo_PageDescription: A read-only presentation of a semantic model: the version diff and the SLA-risk heatmap scenarios, a keyboard element list and a standalone SVG export.
TmModelingViewerDemo_SelectionEmpty: Click an element, or press Enter on a row in the element list.
TmModelingViewerDemo_DiffHint: The diff legend counts every state; removed items stay listed in the text alternative.
TmModelingViewerDemo_HeatHint: Heatmap values are also listed as text in the element list and the legend.
TmModelingViewerDemo_EmptyHint: An empty model renders the empty state instead of a canvas.
TmCalendarHeatmapDemo_Description: Compare daily expenses across a year or focus on a custom date range.
TmCalendarHeatmapDemo_ClickPrompt: Select a day to inspect its expense.
TmResponsiveDemo_Intro: The same dashboard in four containers: 80rem, 58rem, 50rem and a 24rem column. Resize the browser, or force the wide container's layout below — the grid follows its container, not the browser window.
TmResponsiveDemo_RevealHint: Hover or focus to reveal the action. A touch screen shows it immediately.
TmRichEditorDemo_PromotedDrawerIntro: The drawer is in the browser top layer. Open a link, image, table, video or find dialog from the toolbar: it promotes after the drawer and paints above it; Escape closes it and focus returns to the editor.
TmRichEditorDemo_DrawerPlaceholder: Edit in the drawer — dialogs opened from the toolbar stay above it
TmDemo_EmailTemplates_Subtitle: Manage the e-mails your application sends and keep their wording in one place.
TmDemo_EmailTemplates_NoMatchDescription: Nothing matches “{0}”. Try another name or subject.
TmDemo_EmailTemplates_DeleteBody: This template will be permanently deleted. Sent e-mails keep their content.
TmDemo_EmailTemplates_Send_Subtitle: Send a test e-mail with filled-in variables and preview the message.
TmDemo_EmailTemplates_Guard_Message: This template has unsaved changes. Save them before leaving?
TmDemo_AiConversation_Intro: A conversation surface for AI answers: a streamed markdown answer with citations, reasoning and tool calls, per-turn actions, and a prompt composer with slash commands, mentions and attachments. Everything on this page runs locally - the deltas come from an in-page generator, no model is called.
TmDemo_AiConversation_ConversationIntro: Pick a suggestion or type a prompt. The answer streams as ordered parts - reasoning, two tool calls (the second one fails and can be retried), a markdown table, a code block and two cited sources. Stop the generation while it runs, regenerate it to get another version, or rate the answer.
TmDemo_AiConversation_KeyboardHint: Enter sends, Shift+Enter adds a line, / opens the commands, @ opens the mentions and Escape closes the list.
TmDemo_AiConversation_Suggestion1: How is a streamed answer assembled?
TmDemo_AiConversation_Suggestion2: Show the latency numbers as a table
TmDemo_AiConversation_Suggestion3: Why does the second tool call fail?
TmDemo_AiConversation_Submission: Last submit - text: "{0}", model: {1}, attachments: {2}, mentions: {3}, command: {4}
TmDemo_AiConversation_CommandSummarise: Summarise the conversation in five bullets
TmDemo_AiConversation_CommandTranslate: Translate the last answer into Czech
TmDemo_AiConversation_CommandMetrics: Show the latency numbers as a table
TmDemo_AiConversation_FollowUp1: Explain the table step by step
TmDemo_AiConversation_StandaloneIntro: The same components outside a conversation: every tool-call state, the thinking pill in both states, the reasoning panel collapsed and expanded, and a hostile markdown sample.
TmDemo_AiConversation_ToolCallStatesIntr: Queued, running, succeeded, failed, cancelled and a redacted call, plus a run of three consecutive calls collapsed into one summary line. A failed call offers Retry; a redacted one never shows its payload.
TmDemo_AiConversation_ThinkingIntro: The phase pill shimmers while the agent works and ends with a check. Both states are polite live regions.
TmDemo_AiConversation_ReasoningIntro: A disclosure with the steps and the inspected sources: collapsed it reports what the thinking cost, expanded it lists everything.
TmDemo_AiConversation_MarkdownIntro: Raw HTML, an image with an error handler, a javascript:, a data: and a vbscript: link - rendered through the safe pipeline (raw HTML off, URL allowlist, hardened links).
TmDemo_AiConversation_MarkdownSafeNote: Nothing above executed: the raw HTML is escaped text, the refused links point at "#" and the image is gone. The browser console is the proof - no alert, no injected script.
TmDemo_HumanInTheLoop_Intro: The decisions a person makes over a machine's proposal: an approval with a deadline and an Undo window, a twelve-item review queue in both presentations, the inline review of an AI rewrite, and a suggestion with its confidence, reasoning and alternatives. Every surface is a core component; the agent's permission request lives on the AI conversation page.
TmDemo_HumanInTheLoop_ApprovalHeading: Approval with a deadline and Undo
TmDemo_HumanInTheLoop_ApprovalIntro: The card counts down to the deadline, announces the last minute, and keeps Undo open for 30 seconds after a decision. Ctrl+Enter approves and Ctrl+Backspace rejects — but only while focus is inside the card, so a shortcut never fires from a text field.
TmDemo_HumanInTheLoop_ApprovalDescriptio: Accounts payable wants the invoice released today. The amount is above the reviewer's limit, so it needs a second signature.
TmDemo_HumanInTheLoop_ApprovalPreview: Invoice 2026-0042 — implementation of the March–April engagement, 24 person-days, due 2026-04-30.
TmDemo_HumanInTheLoop_QueueIntro: Both presentations of the same queue. Risk and priority disagree on purpose, so the order is the queue's own. A approves, E edits, R rejects and S skips; J/K and the arrow keys move the selection. A decision resolves the item only when the host's callback succeeds, then auto-advance moves to the next one.
TmDemo_HumanInTheLoop_QueueShortcutsHint: Keyboard: A, E, R, S decide; J/K or the arrows navigate.
TmDemo_HumanInTheLoop_DiffHeading: Inline diff — the AI rewrite of one paragraph
TmDemo_HumanInTheLoop_DiffIntro: The proposed rewrite differs in three places. Accept or reject each change on its own (Tab to a change, then Y or N), or use the bulk actions; the line below is the text the diff actually produced, never a copy of one input.
TmDemo_HumanInTheLoop_SuggestionIntro: A recommendation the reader can take, dismiss, or take back inside the Undo window. The confidence is a localized word plus an optional percentage; the reasoning sits behind a disclosure and the alternatives are a native radio group.
TmDemo_HumanInTheLoop_SuggestionText: Model AI draft approvals with the existing ApprovalDecision instead of a second type, so audit entries and reports keep one shape.
TmDemo_HumanInTheLoop_SuggestionRational: The two decisions differ in who asks, not in what is recorded: a reviewer, a timestamp, a note and an outcome. A second model would duplicate the audit trail and every report that reads it.
TmDemo_HumanInTheLoop_SuggestionAlternat: Keep a separate approval model for AI drafts
Defer the decision to the next review
TmDemo_AiConversation_PermissionIntro: An agent asks for one concrete permission: which tool, on which target, and why. The scope radio group decides how long the allowance lasts; the granted row counts down and Revoke hands the permission back. Ctrl+Enter allows, Ctrl+Backspace denies.
TmDemo_AiConversation_PermissionReason: The agent needs the current pricing page to answer the question about the current plan.
TmAppShellDemo_Intro: One composite frame for a whole application page — a top bar, one named navigation column, the content and an optional resizable work area — that resolves its layout from its OWN width. Resize the stage below instead of the browser window: the frame switches between the docked desktop column, the tablet rail with its overlay drawer and the phone drawer at exactly the widths it would in a real application.
TmAppShellDemo_LiveTitle: Live frame in a width-controlled stage
TmAppShellDemo_LiveDescription: The frame measures the stage, never the viewport. The width buttons are the non-drag way to review the three presentations — the same kind of alternative the work area's own separator offers.
TmAppShellDemo_ContentBody: The content is an ordinary child fragment, so any page can live inside the frame. The checklist below keeps its progress here, and Sources is the frame's own resizable work area.
TmAppShellDemo_SourcesIntro: The work area is the frame's right-hand region: a docked, resizable column on desktop and tablet, the same content as a bottom sheet on a phone (where no resize separator renders).
TmAppShellDemo_UserMenuDescription: The same component in its two presentations and its avatar-only trigger: an APG menu button over the shared overlay panel, with the account card, the profile completion block, the theme switch and the host entries. ShowThemeToggle is opt-in and needs a registered ThemeService.
TmAppShellDemo_UserMenuPopoverNote: Auto follows the viewport: an anchored popover on a desktop or tablet viewport and a content-height bottom sheet on a phone.
TmAppShellDemo_UserMenuSheetNote: MobilePresentation=Sheet renders the bottom sheet at any viewport, so the mobile interaction can be reviewed on a desktop.
TmAppShellDemo_UserMenuAvatarOnlyNote: ShowUserName=false gives an icon-only trigger whose accessible name is still the localizable "{name} — user menu" template.
TmAppShellDemo_ChecklistDescription: One model, three presentations. Every step is a native checkbox with its own label, groups are APG disclosures, a completion is announced once in a polite live region and only the optional auto-collapse moves the focus.
TmAppShellDemo_ChecklistDismissNote: Dismissible closes the guide locally in every case, even without a bound handler; the host brings it back with a NEW task list identity, which the checklist treats as a new run.
TmAppShellDemo_TaskConnectDescription: Pick a database or upload a file.
TmAppShellDemo_StageLabel: Frame preview stage — the live frame measures this box, not the browser window. Scroll it when a preset is wider than the demo column.
TmDemo_ActivityComments_ToggleMessageInt: Everyone who can open this thread will see the comment. Notifications already sent cannot be recalled.
TmDemo_ActivityComments_ToggleMessagePub: Only privileged users should see an internal comment. The component does not hide it — your app must filter it. Notifications already sent cannot be recalled.
TmDemo_ActivityComments_SimulateFailureH: When on, the save handler returns failure after a short delay: the composer stays open with your text and the reason shows in an alert.
TmDemo_ActivityComments_SaveFailedMessag: The server rejected the comment (simulated). Your text is still in the editor — fix it and try again, or turn the simulation off.
TmDemo_ActivityComments_EditFailedMessag: The server rejected the edit (simulated). The inline editor stays open with your text.
TmDataDisplayDemo_TraceWaterfallHint: A generated agent trace: the root run, its LLM and tool calls and a failed HTTP request. Start the live trace to watch the running spans grow, and select a row to open its detail.
TmDataDisplayDemo_UsageMeterHint: How much of a monthly credit quota is gone: the category breakdown, the reset date, the daily history and a call to action that only appears once the usage is near the limit.
TmDataDisplayDemo_SegmentedHint: One value out of a small set. The left cards keep radio semantics (arrows move the choice, one segment is the tab stop); the right card is a tablist whose selected tab points at the panel below it. The narrow copy scrolls sideways instead of clipping its last segment.
TmDataDisplayDemo_SegmentedPanel: The {0} panel. Every tab of the switcher points at this region with aria-controls.
TmFormsDemo_MatchHighlightHint: Both behaviours are opt-in: HighlightMatches wraps the typed term in the matching rows, and AllowCreate offers a create row as the LAST option when nothing matches exactly. Type to see it; press ArrowDown and Enter to pick the create row.
TmAnalyticsKitDemo_PageDescription: A reporting screen assembled from the data and analytics kit: a period with a comparison window, KPI cards, a change summary, a channel breakdown, a comparison chart, a faceted filter over the order history and a quota meter.
TmAnalyticsKitDemo_ComparisonDays: {0} days, the same length as the period
TmAnalyticsKitDemo_KpiHint: The four figures a reporting header needs. Each one compares the period with its comparison window, carries a sparkline of the period and animates to its value.
TmAnalyticsKitDemo_TrendHint: One row per metric: its value, its change against the comparison window and the history of the period. The direction is carried by an arrow, a word and a colour, so colour is never the only cue.
TmAnalyticsKitDemo_BreakdownHint: The same period split by acquisition channel. The switcher flips to the comparison window, which re-sorts the rows — the reorder is a CSS-only FLIP that reduced motion suppresses.
TmAnalyticsKitDemo_ChartHint: Both series share one axis and one tooltip. Focus the chart and press the right or left arrow to walk the points; Escape hides the card.
TmAnalyticsKitDemo_FacetsHint: The counts are computed by the page, not by the component: an option's number applies every other group's selection, so removing a chip re-counts the remaining groups.
TmAnalyticsKitDemo_UsageHint: The report's own quota: how much of the monthly credit allowance the period consumed. Spend another slab and watch the meter walk through warning, critical and over the limit.
TmTraceWaterfallDemo_PageDescription: One agent run rendered by TmTraceWaterfall: the planning call, thirty-two decision rounds with their HTTP and DB children, a retried request, a nested sub-agent, a failed notification and the live mode that keeps the running bars growing.
TmTraceWaterfallDemo_LiveOn: Live: the running spans grow every second
TmTraceWaterfallDemo_Hint: Expand a subtree with the right arrow and collapse it with the left one, walk the rows with the up and down arrows, select one with Enter or Space and zoom the axis with plus, minus or the reset button. The detail panel follows the selection.
TmSortableListDemo_PageDescription: A list a reader can reorder by dragging, by keyboard, or from each row's move menu — with one polite live region narrating every step.
TmSortableListDemo_BasicHint: Drag the grip to reorder, or focus a row and press Enter to pick it up, the arrows to move it and Enter to drop it. Escape cancels. The menu button on each row does the same without a drag.
TmSortableListDemo_KeyboardHint: Keyboard: Enter/Space picks a row up, arrows move it, Enter/Space drops it, Escape cancels, Alt+arrow moves it one position.
TmSortableListDemo_ModesTitle: Handle mode and the read-only list
TmSortableListDemo_ModesHint: The left list drags from the whole row (a touch press has to be held, so tapping and scrolling still work). The right one is disabled: its rows stay readable and focusable-free, and nothing can be reordered.
TmSortableListDemo_ReadOnlyHint: A disabled list renders no move menu, no focus stop and no drag — the same rows, without the reorder contract.
TmSortableListDemo_EmptyHint: An empty list keeps the keyboard instructions and the live region, so it still explains itself and a host's own empty content takes the place of the default sentence.
TmSortableListDemo_EmptySlot: Nothing queued yet — add a step to start.
TmAgentPlanDemo_PageDescription: The agent's plan of steps: review and edit it, then watch the same rows while it runs.
TmAgentPlanDemo_ReviewHint: Rename a step with F2 or a click on its title, add a step below a row or at the end, remove one and Undo it, or reorder with the row grip. Every change is reported to this page, which owns the list.
TmAgentPlanDemo_EditReorder: Moved the step at position {0} to position {1}.
TmAgentPlanDemo_KeyboardHint: Keyboard: F2 renames, Enter saves, Escape cancels, Enter on a row picks it up and the arrows move it.
TmAgentPlanDemo_RunningHint: The same rows read-only: four steps are done, one is running with a live clock, one failed with its error and Retry, one is still waiting.
TmAgentPlanDemo_Retried: The page restarted the run from “{0}”.
TmAgentPlanDemo_RunningHintNote: A running plan is read-only: the only action left is Retry on a failed step.
TmAgentPlanDemo_ReadOnlyTitle: A review that may only be approved
TmAgentPlanDemo_ReadOnlyHint: AllowEditing="false" keeps the rows and the Approve action but removes every edit path.
TmAgentPlanDemo_RunStep6Error: The mailbox connection timed out after 30 s.
TmAgentRunDemo_PageDescription: One agent run on two surfaces: the tree of agents, sub-agents and tool calls with the subtree totals of their parents, and the live monitor that folds into one status bar.
TmAgentRunDemo_TreeHint: A flat node list becomes a treegrid. A parent row shows its whole subtree's cost, tokens and time and says so in its accessible name; the failed lookup keeps its ancestors visible under the filter; the row you select fills the detail panel from the same public roll-up helper.
TmAgentRunDemo_KeyboardHint: Keyboard: the up and down arrows walk the rows, the left and right arrows collapse and expand, Home and End jump, and Enter or Space selects a row.
TmAgentRunDemo_NoAdvance: The run has not moved yet.
TmAgentRunDemo_AdvanceFinished: The writer runs and the root completes.
TmAgentRunDemo_MonitorHint: The strip shows the current step, a clock that ticks only while the run is running, the cost so far and the steps' timeline. The approval slot is the host's own decision surface; the toggle folds everything but the essentials into one bar.
TmAgentRunDemo_CollapsedHint: The toggle works by keyboard and touch; the bar keeps the state, the current step, the clock and the cost.
TmAgentRunDemo_CollapsedBody: A collapsed monitor keeps the essentials and says that an approval is waiting, so nobody has to unfold it to discover the run is blocked on them.
TmAgentRunDemo_EdgeHint: The components treat the host's list as untrusted: a node whose parent is missing hangs under the root as a marked orphan, a parent cycle is rejected instead of hanging the grid, and nothing throws.
TmAgentRunDemo_EdgeLabel: A run with an orphan and a cycle
TmModelPickerDemo_PageDescription: Pick the model a conversation runs on and compare the catalogue on speed, quality, price and context window.
TmModelPickerDemo_BasicHint: The trigger opens the catalogue; the selected model's reasoning options sit above the list and the estimate prices the next prompt.
TmModelPickerDemo_VariantsHint: The same catalogue grouped by family, and a toolbar-sized picker without the search field or the comparison bars.
TmModelPickerDemo_EventsHint: CloseOnSelect=false keeps the list open, and every change is reported as one AiModelSelection.
TmModelPickerDemo_EdgeHint: No catalogue, a disabled control, a deprecated model, a retired model and a host-owned price vocabulary.
TmModelPickerDemo_EdgeEmptyHint: The popup says so instead of rendering an empty list.
TmModelPickerDemo_EdgeDisabledHint: Nothing opens and nothing is raised.
TmModelPickerDemo_EdgeDeprecatedHint: Still selectable, marked in the trigger and in its row.
TmModelPickerDemo_EdgeMissingHint: A selection outside the catalogue is still named by its id.
TmModelPickerDemo_EdgeFormatterHint: The host's own money vocabulary replaces the currency format.
TmModelPickerDemo_ModelFlagship: The flagship: strong on quality, slower and pricier.
TmModelPickerDemo_ModelLegacy: A retired model kept for existing conversations.
TmContextUsageDemo_PageDescription: What the context window of a conversation is made of: the system prompt, the tools, the memory, the files, the chat and the tool results, measured against the model's budget — with the parts the reader can still drop.
TmContextUsageDemo_BasicHint: Six sections of a working conversation, 14 000 of 16 000 tokens. Expand a section to see its entries, remove one, or compact the optional parts; the page applies what the panel reports.
TmContextUsageDemo_LogTurn: The next turn added 2 500 chat tokens.
TmContextUsageDemo_VariantsTitle: The same snapshot in three presentations
TmContextUsageDemo_VariantsHint: The bar is the default; the grid shows the free headroom one cell per percent, and the treemap draws the sections (and their entries) as areas. The legend, the meter and the actions are identical in all three.
TmContextUsageDemo_EdgeHint: What the panel does when the host reports nothing, more than the budget, no budget at all, or no cache measurement.
TmContextUsageDemo_EdgeEmptyHint: A snapshot with no sections renders the localized empty state instead of an empty chart.
TmContextUsageDemo_EdgeOverHint: A known budget that is exceeded: the excess is named and the meter reports the real amount.
TmContextUsageDemo_EdgeUnknownHint: A model that reports no context window: no percentage is claimed and nothing is over budget.
TmContextUsageDemo_EdgeNoCacheHint: A provider that does not report a cache hit renders no badge at all.
TmAiAgentsDemo_PageDescription: One scenario end to end: review the agent's plan, let it run (one step fails and is retried), watch the same run in the tree and in the live monitor, pick the model, measure the context window and assemble a prompt.
TmAiAgentsDemo_DemoNotice: Demo data: the models, prices, token counts and runs on this page are invented for the demo. Nothing here calls a provider and nothing is a real bill.
TmAiAgentsDemo_PlanTitle: Review the plan, then let it run
TmAiAgentsDemo_PlanHint: Every edit is proposed to this page, which owns the plan. Start the run with {0} and watch the steps complete; the second step fails on purpose and offers {1}.
TmAiAgentsDemo_StateReview: The plan is waiting for you to start it.
TmAiAgentsDemo_StateRunning: The run is going: {0} of {1} steps done.
TmAiAgentsDemo_StateFailed: “{0}” failed: {1} Retry from that step to continue.
TmAiAgentsDemo_StateApproval: The last step is waiting for your approval.
TmAiAgentsDemo_StateRejected: You rejected the last step, so the run finished without it.
TmAiAgentsDemo_PlanKeyboardHint: Reorder a step with the grip or with Enter and the arrow keys; F2 renames it and the row menu is the tap alternative. The failed step offers {0} while the plan runs.
TmAiAgentsDemo_NoEdit: The plan has not been edited yet.
TmAiAgentsDemo_EditReorder: Moved the step from position {0} to {1}.
TmAiAgentsDemo_StepError: The ledger service timed out after 30 s.
TmAiAgentsDemo_LanesTitle: Agent lanes — the same run in time
TmAiAgentsDemo_LanesHint: One lane per agent on a shared axis: a block per activity, the review verdict on the block that carries it, handoff arrows and the current moment as a live line. Zoom changes the scale; the Table view carries exactly the same blocks and handoffs.
TmAiAgentsDemo_TreeHint: A root, three sub-agents and the tool calls they made. The root row rolls the whole subtree up; the failed matcher keeps its ancestors visible under the filter, and the arrow keys walk the rows exactly like the standalone treegrid.
TmAiAgentsDemo_TreeMatchError: The matcher stopped after the ledger lookup failed.
TmAiAgentsDemo_MonitorHint: The monitor follows the simulated run: the current step, the clock, the cost and the timeline. The last step is gated by a real approval — decide it with the card in the monitor's approval slot.
TmAiAgentsDemo_MonitorHintNote: {0} resumes the run and completes it; {1} skips the last step and finishes the run.
TmAiAgentsDemo_ApprovalWaiting: Nothing is waiting for a decision.
TmAiAgentsDemo_ApprovalApproved: The page received {0} and the run is finishing.
TmAiAgentsDemo_ApprovalRejected: The page received {0} and the last step was skipped.
TmAiAgentsDemo_ApprovalDescription: The agent wants to publish the reconciliation summary for the closed ledger period.
TmAiAgentsDemo_ModelsHint: The catalogue compares six demo models on speed, quality, price per million input tokens and context window; the selected model's reasoning options sit above the list and the monitor's Model metric follows the choice.
TmAiAgentsDemo_ModelsFictional: A fictional catalogue: the provider names, prices and scores are invented for the demo and are not a real price list.
TmAiAgentsDemo_ModelsKeyboardHint: Open with Enter or the down arrow, search, walk the list with the arrow keys and pick with Enter; the effort control is a segmented radio group.
TmAiAgentsDemo_ModelAuroraPro: The demo's flagship: strong on quality, slower and pricier.
TmAiAgentsDemo_ModelAuroraFlash: The cheap, fast workhorse of the demo catalogue.
TmAiAgentsDemo_ModelNimbus: A balanced middle model with vision and tools.
TmAiAgentsDemo_ModelCirrus: A small, quick model for short tasks.
TmAiAgentsDemo_ModelAtlas: A million-token window with the strongest quality score.
TmAiAgentsDemo_ModelLocal: A local demo model that runs offline.
TmAiAgentsDemo_ContextHint: One snapshot in all three presentations. Every variant binds the same removal and compaction handlers: expand a section to drop one entry, drop a whole section or compact the optional parts — the page applies what the panel reports.
TmAiAgentsDemo_PromptsHint: Five templates with generated variable forms and a live preview. Fill the fields and press {0}; the page shows the exact assembled prompt.
TmAiAgentsDemo_UsedEmpty: No prompt has been used yet.
TmAiAgentsDemo_UsedHint: The preview and the payload come from the same parser pass, so what you see is exactly what a host would send.
TmAiAgentsDemo_TemplateReleaseDescriptio: A release announcement focused on the change the reader cares about.
TmAiAgentsDemo_TemplateReleaseBody: Write release notes for {{product}} version {{version}}. Focus on {{focus}} and keep the summary under 150 words.
TmAiAgentsDemo_TemplateReviewDescription: A risk-focused review of a diff.
TmAiAgentsDemo_TemplateReviewBody:
Review this diff and list the risks, the missing tests and the questions a reviewer should ask:

{{diff}}
TmAiAgentsDemo_TemplateReplyDescription: A support answer in the requested tone.
TmAiAgentsDemo_TemplateReplyBody: Reply to {{customer}} about {{topic}}. Keep the answer {{tone}} and end with one concrete next step.
TmAiAgentsDemo_TemplateSummaryDescriptio: Turn raw notes into decisions and actions.
TmAiAgentsDemo_TemplateSummaryBody:
Summarise the notes below in {{language}}. Separate the decisions from the open questions and list the actions with their owners.

{{notes}}
TmAiAgentsDemo_TemplateBriefDescription: A short brief for a non-technical audience.
TmAiAgentsDemo_TemplateBriefBody: Analyse {{dataset}} and explain the trend to {{audience}} in plain language, without jargon.
TmAiAgentsDemo_VariableDiffHint: Paste the unified diff you want reviewed.
TmAiAgentsDemo_ApprovalPending: The run is waiting for your decision.
TmAiAgentsDemo_GraphTitle: The same run as a network
TmAiAgentsDemo_GraphHint: Agents, the tools they call and the ledger they read as one network. The arrow keys walk a connection, Home and End jump to the first and last node, Enter selects a node and the View switch carries the same numbers as two tables.
TmAiAgentsDemo_FanOutHint: The page's live run splits eighteen units of work across four workers: one has failed and can be retried, two are still waiting for a worker and the rest are done or running. The dataset switch below shows the same grid with 0, 1 or 200 units — a FROZEN fixture, with the live fan-out paused until you pick Live again.
TmAiAgentsDemo_FanOutFixtureNote: A frozen {0} fixture — the live fan-out is paused.
TmAiAgentsDemo_ParallelHint: Three attempts at the same task with the votes each one collected. Choose a winner, confirm it and the page records the result.
TmAiAgentsDemo_ParallelChosen: The page accepted {0} as the result.
TmAiAgentsDemo_HandoffHint: The same run passed from agent to agent: what each handoff carried, what it dropped and why.
TmAiAgentsDemo_FallbackHint: The models tried for one request, in order: which one answered, which failed and why, and the order this page would fall back through.
TmAiAgentsDemo_AutonomyHint: How much the agent may do on its own: a change above the last grade asks first, and the limits a tenant enforces sit beside the choice.
TmAiAgentsDemo_MemoryHint: What the agent remembers about the workspace: edit a fact, pause it, forget it (with an undo window) or review what the agent proposed.
TmAiAgentsDemo_DelegateHint: Work waiting to be handed out: drag a card onto an agent (or use its Assign menu), and watch the automatic pass fill the free slots. An agent at capacity refuses the drop and says why.
TmAiAgentsDemo_RunsHint: Runs placed into the scheduler's windows: the capacity each window offers, what the host has already committed, a run split across two windows and one window the host over-committed.
TmAiAgentsDemo_ConflictHint: Three agents on three branches over the same repository. Two paths were changed by two agents each: settle every conflict by keeping one agent's version or merging the file by hand, and the Merge action becomes available.
TmAiAgentsDemo_ConflictResolved: {0} conflict(s) settled — the page stores the reader's decisions.
TmAiAgentsDemo_PresenceHint: The same document with three collaborators over it: the demo adapter turns the collaboration feed's cursors into presence markers anchored to the paragraphs below, and the roster names everyone present for a screen reader.
TmAiAgentsDemo_PresenceDocumentLead: The quarterly plan starts with the goals the team agreed on, each with an owner and a review date.
TmAiAgentsDemo_PresenceDocumentBody: Work that nobody owns is listed as an open question instead of being assigned silently, so the plan never claims an owner who never agreed.
TmAiAgentsDemo_PresenceDocumentClose: Every goal is reviewed at the end of the quarter; a goal that missed its date is carried into the next plan with the reason it slipped.
TmAiAgentVizDemo_PageDescription: One simulated multi-agent run, drawn by every agent surface of the package at the same time: the lanes, the graph, the fan-out, the parallel attempts, the handoff chain, the fallback chain, the autonomy dial, the memory panel, the delegate board, the scheduled runs, the conflict radar and the presence overlay.
TmAiAgentVizDemo_DemoNotice: Demo data: the agents, files, memories and runs on this page are invented, and nothing calls a model provider. The simulator is a host-side timer, exactly as an application would drive the same components from a hub or a poll.
TmAiAgentVizDemo_SimHint: Ten changes per second at 1× travel through one monotonic sequence. Play, pause and the speed are the host's own controls; the components only render what they are handed.
TmAiAgentVizDemo_SimKeyboardHint: The controls are native buttons and a segmented control: Tab to one and press Enter or Space. The run keeps going while you read, and the read-outs above are visible text, so nothing shouts every event.
TmAiAgentVizDemo_ResetAnnounce: The run is back at its opening snapshot.
TmAiAgentVizDemo_LanesHint: The same run on one time axis: a block per piece of work, the verdict a block carries, the handoff arrows between the agents and the current moment as a live line. The surface's own switch renders the same layout as two tables.
TmAiAgentVizDemo_GraphHint: Agents, the tools they call and the ledger they read as one network. This is the one surface fed the incremental path: every call the simulator reports travels as its own AgentGraphCall event and pulses the edge it used.
TmAiAgentVizDemo_FanOutHint: Forty units of work across four workers, with the retry of a failed unit and a queue that loops instead of growing. The page's table presentation is the text alternative.
TmAiAgentVizDemo_AttemptsHint: Three drafts at the same task, scored and voted on. The page records only the draft the reader confirms; the table presentation lists the same scores as text.
TmAiAgentVizDemo_HandoffHint: The same work passed from agent to agent: what each handoff carried, what it dropped and what is still waiting for an acceptance. The chain's own switch renders the same steps as a table.
TmAiAgentVizDemo_FallbackHint: The models tried for one request and the chain the page would fall back through. The chain's own Flow/Table switch is the text alternative; the editor reorders the chain by drag, by its move menu and with the keyboard.
TmAiAgentVizDemo_AutonomyHint: How much the agent may do on its own. A change above the last grade asks first, and the tenant's locks are listed beside the stops. The dial answers the arrows, Home and End.
TmAiAgentVizDemo_MemoryHint: Twenty facts over four categories. The page is the store: an edit, a pause, a review decision and a removal all change its own list, and a forgotten fact is only gone when the panel's undo window closes.
TmAiAgentVizDemo_DelegateHint: Work waiting to be handed out. A drag has its Assign menu and the automatic pass as the tap and keyboard alternatives, and a full agent refuses the move with a visible notice.
TmAiAgentVizDemo_RunsHint: A week of runs placed into the scheduler's windows, with the capacity each window offers. The surface's Week/Day/Table switch is the text alternative, and a move is also available from the run's menu.
TmAiAgentVizDemo_ConflictHint: Three agents on three branches over the same twenty-five files, with four real conflicts. Every conflict carries its own side choice, and the merge waits until every one of them is settled.
TmAiAgentVizDemo_PresenceHint: The page renders the document itself and its paragraphs carry the anchors; the overlay measures them, so a cursor follows a reflow. Play the cursors and they move with the simulated run; the roster names everyone present as text.
TmAiAgentVizDemo_BadgeHint: The identity line every agent surface reuses, at all three densities, with the activity state carried by an icon, a word and a tone — never by colour alone.
TmAiAgentVizDemo_TableHelp: The same data as text: reachable by keyboard and readable by a screen reader.
TmAiAgentVizDemo_FanOutTableCaption: Fan-out units, their worker, state and attempt
TmAiAgentVizDemo_AttemptsTableCaption: Parallel attempts with their state, score and votes
TmAiAgentVizDemo_MemoryTableCaption: Remembered facts by category, state and confidence
TmAiAgentVizDemo_DelegateTableCaption: Tasks waiting to be handed out, with their grade, estimate and agent
TmAiAgentVizDemo_ConflictTableCaption: Every change on every branch, file by file
TmAiAgentVizDemo_PresenceTableCaption: Everyone present, their role, activity and anchor
TmAiAgentVizDemo_PresenceDocumentLead: The quarterly plan starts with the goals the team agreed on, each with an owner and a review date reading.
TmAiAgentVizDemo_PresenceDocumentGoal: A goal that has no owner is listed as an open question instead of being assigned silently to whoever is closest reading.
TmAiAgentVizDemo_PresenceDocumentRisk: Every goal carries its risk note, so a reader sees the assumption a date depends on before the date slips reading.
TmAiAgentVizDemo_PresenceDocumentClose: Every goal is reviewed at the end of the quarter, and a goal that missed its date is carried into the next plan with its reason attached.
